consequence.statement: No operational consequence for an operator who does nothing: OTEL_PROPAGATORS is a newly supported opt-in setting for tracing propagation; environments that set it can now configure propagation with it.

assertion.statement: Traefik 3.0.0 adds support for the OTEL_PROPAGATORS environment variable to configure tracing propagation.
